interface.name: z_systalia_manager_v1

description.summary: Factory for per-surface VALO optical metadata

interface.description: The compositor advertises one manager global. Each wl_surface can have at most one live optical controller. Values are applied immediately, in wire order, independently of wl_surface.commit. All lengths use surface-local logical pixels. Destroying the manager leaves existing controllers valid.

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: surface is not a live surface of this client

interface.name: z_systalia_surface_v1

description.summary: Optical parameters associated with one wl_surface

interface.description: Defaults are radii (18,18,18,18), slant 0, IOR 1.25, dispersion 0.04 and meniscus width 28. Parameters are Wayland signed 24.8 fixed-point values. Destroying this controller restores compositor defaults. Destroying its wl_surface removes the metadata; subsequent setters report invalid_surface. The inert controller may still be destroyed safely by the client. Meniscus width is negotiated metadata; rendering support is compositor-defined.

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: parameter is outside its supported range

request.name: set_corner_radii

description.summary: Set independent G2 radii in TL, TR, BL, BR order

request.description: Each radius must be nonnegative. The renderer constrains the effective radius to the window dimensions without changing this metadata.

description.summary: Set perspective slant between -1 and 1 inclusive

request.name: set_optical_properties

description.summary: Set IOR, chromatic dispersion and meniscus width atomically

request.description: IOR must be in [1,3], dispersion in [0,1], and meniscus width must be positive. A rejected tuple changes none of the optical properties.
